install.notes: pyproject.toml:4 requires Python 3.11 or newer, and the dependency list at :6-18 includes mujoco and gymnasium; the code also imports numpy (src/so100_mujoco_rl/envs/env_base_01.py:5). The gate and the fake backend need none of them: fake.py is pure Python and the gate never installs or imports the upstream package. Install the upstream only to serve the real Env01-v1 environment (backend sim), which was not run.
